value.behaviour: Unit tests for HomePageUnreadNotifications, deep-link highlighting on NotificationsPage/NotificationsTable, live signal updates, polling fallback, and plugin registrations.
rules: 1. Start with the 2026 Backstage Apache-2.0 license header.

2. Use renderInTestApp and TestApiProvider from @backstage/test-utils and screen / findBy* / findAllBy* / fireEvent / act from @testing-library/react without any data-testid, test-only attributes, or *ByTestId queries.

3. Provide mock implementations for notificationsApiRef, signalApiRef (from @backstage/plugin-signals-react), and toastApiRef (from @backstage/frontend-plugin-api), mounting rootRouteRef at '/notifications' in renderInTestApp.

4. Test fetching unread notifications with { read: false, limit: 5, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc' }, rendering notification titles/metadata, rendering empty state when notifications is [], and rendering error state when getNotifications rejects.
5. Test clicking the mark-as-read button calls updateNotifications({ ids: [id], read: true }) and removes the item from the rendered list.
6. Test emitting new_notification, notification_read, and notification_unread on the 'notifications' signal channel triggers getNotifications refresh.

7. Test polling fallback with jest.useFakeTimers() when isSignalsAvailable is false (no signalApiRef or mocked useSignal with isSignalsAvailable: false) and verify clearInterval cleans up the polling timer on unmount.

8. Test each notification item links to '/notifications?id=<id>' via rootRouteRef and rendering NotificationsPage at '/notifications?id=<id>' visually highlights the matching notification row by querying rows with screen.findByRole('row', { name: ... }) or screen.findAllByRole('row') and asserting only on the matching row's visible highlight background style compared against non-matching rows.

style_from.reason: Follows renderInTestApp and React Testing Library conventions in plugins/notifications.

uses.reason: Verifies highlighted row visual styling in NotificationsTable.

tests.name: fetches and renders latest unread notifications and links each item to /notifications?id=<id>
tests.expect: getNotifications is called with { read: false, limit: 5, sort: 'created', sortOrder: 'desc' }, notification titles and metadata are rendered, and each title link points to /notifications?id=<id>

tests.name: renders empty state when there are no unread notifications
tests.given: notificationsApi.getNotifications resolves with an empty notifications array
tests.expect: The 'No unread notifications' empty state message is displayed

tests.name: marks a notification as read and removes it from the unread list
tests.given: An unread notification is rendered in the card and the user clicks its Mark as read button
tests.expect: notificationsApi.updateNotifications is called with { ids: [id], read: true } and the notification is removed from the rendered list

tests.name: refreshes unread notifications when a notifications signal is received
tests.given: The card is subscribed to the 'notifications' signal channel and a new_notification, notification_read, or notification_unread signal arrives
tests.expect: notificationsApi.getNotifications is called again and the updated unread list is rendered

tests.name: falls back to polling when signals are unavailable and cleans up interval on unmount
tests.given: isSignalsAvailable is false and fake timers advance by the polling interval
tests.expect: notificationsApi.getNotifications is called periodically on each interval tick and no further calls occur after unmount

tests.name: highlights the matching notification on NotificationsPage when navigated to /notifications?id=<id>
tests.given: NotificationsPage is rendered at route /notifications?id=notif-2 with multiple notifications
tests.expect: Querying rows via screen.findByRole('row', { name: ... }) shows the matching notification row has the visible highlight background styling while non-matching rows do not
